_doc: Inputs for credit-review.py decide (credit-trust-decide, trust-yet-verify, captain 2026-10-15 ~22:12Z). Rows of these users/profiles are NEVER provisionally approved by the decider; they get the support request (user_verification_needed) instead. Ids only. There are no named-user rules (captain correction): a high-risk case is caught by the score (big track, conflicts, red flags), never by an id here. Sources: deny_user_ids = credit-authenticity-audit-a1 accounts_ranked_2026.csv actions PULL/HOLD/RE-VERIFY + credit-retro-hold-docfraud-f1 tiers.csv HOLD users; deny_profile_ids = cmux 1346 fleet scan profiles with >= 30% of sampled claims held, plus stillfloo. Adding an id is always safe (it only routes rows to a human/support request); removing one needs Fable or a named admin. editorial_role_terms: claimed roles with a word starting with one of these (Editor, Vocal Editing, Compilation, Pro Tools ...) are high risk; the decider approves them only on trusted catalog confirmation under pop 30 and uvn-under30 never approves them. This file is read by BOTH automations (scripts/credit_review/decide.py and scripts/uvn-under30-cron.py). Reviewed baseline: deploy overwrites - 2026-10-26 (claim-lane-resume-c2, firstmate 010): this blob = node-8's 2026-10-23 19:46Z hot-patch (max_profiles_per_run 500 -> 150) + main's 0df73a96 watchlist ids; nothing on node-8 is lost. 2026-11-04 (Fable d2 [key=decider-support-arm]): the decider is a SUPPORT-ONLY writer. `approve_arm: false` is enforced IN CODE (scripts/credit_review/decide.py: approve_arm_off / the write_ids tripwire): an approve verdict is still recorded in the ledger for stage 2, and is never written. Flipping this to true is a reviewed policy PR and still refuses while /etc/hydra/credit-trust-decide-approve.disabled exists. `max_ask_users_per_run: 100` caps DISTINCT USERS per run (paid first; a user's whole batch stays together), next to max_ask_users_per_day. See docs/credit-verification/decider-support-arm.md.

score_approve._doc: credit-review.py score-approve (cron credit-trust-score-approve-15m): the validator's approve verdict executed on held user_verification_needed rows with total risk < max_total_risk (captain 2026-10-20 ~11:30Z 'approve low risk credits'). Every other guard stays: validator conflict / reject rule / server guard / big or unattributable track / org role / deny lists / per-user daily cap. max_total_risk <= 30 and max_popularity <= 60 are enforced in code. Fable band-B ruling 2026-10-20 (data/credit-trust-system-fable-a1/ruling-score-approve-band-b-2026-10-20.md): admit_band_b stays false until core's T12 twin admitting validator-approved band B is LIVE; caps 20/user, 50/profile, 2,000 fleet per day (code-enforced maxima). max_per_run 50 (the lane's ruling item (c) 'cap 50 per run', passed into the task brief as the required cap and confirmed by firstmate 2026-11-14: 50 is the number that bounds the live approve path once this job is armed, and it is inert until then because the cron row credit-trust-score-approve-15m is enabled: false; the code ceiling stays 100, so raising this number is a decision, pinned by test_credit_score_approve.py). An account the gate allows but does not band green (amber fraud watch, a released red, an unread band) is not approved: account_gate.watch_refusal.

_doc_max_documented_uvn_users_per_run: decide.hold_documented_uvn: distinct users per run whose requests ALREADY in user_verification_needed, with a document on file, get the decider's 'proof on file' hold (stage 2's only input). Ledger rows only: no core write, no ask, no approval. 10 a run is 40 an hour, which is what credit-verify-proof-stage2 takes (--max-users 40). 0 turns the pass off. Measured 2026-11-13: 28,688 such requests of 2,598 users had no hold (data/send-families-zero-sends-r1/report.md).
